title: Dark Horse Coffee
summary: Commercial tenant improvement converting an existing shop into a coffee and bakery concept. The project included interior remodeling, equipment layout, ADA accessibility improvements, plumbing, electrical, lighting, and mechanical coordination.
projectDetails: Conversion of an existing ice cream shop into a coffee, bakery, and ice cream concept
Interior remodel with no change to the existing B occupancy classification
ADA accessibility improvements including a compliant unisex restroom and customer checkout area
Commercial kitchen and food preparation layout
Espresso bar, bakery preparation, and serving counter design
Grease interceptor and plumbing system coordination
Restaurant equipment planning and utility coordination
Permit-ready construction documents for City of San Diego approval
highlights: Adaptive reuse of an existing commercial tenant space
Designed for coffee, bakery, and ice cream operations
Integrated kitchen equipment and workflow planning
Coordinated plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and ventilation systems
Modern customer ordering and serving experience
Construction documents coordinated across multiple engineering disciplines
